per_name.description: Pulse-integrated heat deposited in a plasma-facing component, including heat recovered during post-discharge cooling as the component returns toward thermal equilibrium.
per_name.holder_description: Total energy extracted from a calorimetry component over the whole discharge.

per_name.description: Rate of change of the area enclosed by a closed magnetic flux surface’s poloidal cross-section as its signed poloidal magnetic-flux label varies.
per_name.holder_description: Rate at which the poloidal-plane area enclosed by a nested magnetic flux surface changes with signed poloidal magnetic flux; it supplies a geometric metric for flux-surface averages.

per_name.description: Electron average temperature at midplane is the path-length-weighted mean electron kinetic temperature along an open scrape-off-layer magnetic field line between its upstream midplane crossing and its connected downstream divertor target.
per_name.holder_description: Electron temperature averaged along an open magnetic field line between upstream and downstream locations in the scrape-off layer.

per_name.description: Local kinetic temperature of the electron population at the outboard, low-field-side midplane in the scrape-off layer.
per_name.holder_description: Energy-equivalent measure of the mean random kinetic energy per electron in the bulk electron population, defined by its second velocity moment.

per_name.description: Electrostatic potential at wall is the voltage-valued scalar potential of the plasma immediately adjacent to a plasma-facing wall, relative to a chosen electrical reference.
per_name.holder_description: Local plasma electrostatic potential evaluated at a Langmuir-probe position in the edge or boundary plasma, distinct from the floating potential established by zero net probe current.

per_name.description: Energy flux at the wall due to eddy current is the thermal energy flux density emitted from a plasma-facing wall surface toward the plasma by heat generated from eddy-current Joule dissipation in conducting structures.
per_name.holder_description: Local energy flux density entering each plasma-facing wall element from the plasma side, attributed specifically to eddy-current processes rather than emitted wall energy.

per_name.description: Total volumetric generation rate of fast, suprathermal electrons, summed over all relevant production mechanisms. It counts creation into the fast-electron population and excludes transport losses or explicit sink terms in the number-density balance.
per_name.holder_description: Plasma-volume-averaged volumetric production rate of runaway electrons, summed over Dreicer, avalanche, hot-tail, Compton, and tritium-decay generation mechanisms.

per_name.description: Volumetric production rate of fast electrons created when high-energy gamma rays Compton-scatter from free plasma electrons; subsequent losses and evolution are excluded.
per_name.holder_description: Local volumetric rate at which high-energy gamma-ray Compton scattering produces electrons that enter the runaway regime.

per_name.description: Volumetric production rate of fast electrons due to hot-tail generation during a rapid thermal quench is the local production into the fast-electron population when an initially hotter high-energy tail does not rethermalize with the cooling bulk. It is not restricted to electrons satisfying a runaway-electron criterion.
per_name.holder_description: Volumetric production rate of runaway electrons generated when the high-energy tail survives rapid thermal-quench cooling.

per_name.description: Length of a passive conducting structure is the Euclidean length of its beta-side inclined edge in an oblique parallelogram cross-section, evaluated in a constant-φ poloidal plane of the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, where R is major radius and Z is vertical height.
per_name.holder_description: Length of the minor, beta-inclined side of a parallelogram-shaped cross-section in a passive conductor element.

per_name.description: Maximum total power deposited on the inner, high-field-side divertor target over a specified interval, integrating all incident energy channels across the wetted strike-zone surface.
per_name.holder_description: Peak local energy-deposition rate per unit area on one divertor target surface, combining incident plasma-particle and radiative energy-carrying channels.

per_name.description: Maximum total power deposited on the outer divertor target by all incident energy channels over a specified interval, evaluated from the wetted strike-zone power.
per_name.holder_description: Peak local energy-deposition rate per unit area on one divertor target surface, combining incident plasma-particle and radiative energy-carrying channels.

per_name.description: Nuclear charge number of the neutral-beam species, equal to the integer count of protons in its nucleus and invariant across ionization states and isotopes.
per_name.holder_description: Charge number of the ion species from which a diagnostic neutral beam particle is produced, specifying its pre-neutralization ionization state rather than the neutral particle's net charge.

per_name.description: Total neutron production rate from fusion reactions, integrated over the plasma volume and summed across reaction channels and reacting-population classes.
per_name.holder_description: Total neutron emission rate produced by deuterium–tritium, deuterium–deuterium, and tritium–tritium fusion reactions in the plasma.

per_name.description: External (outward) half-width of the hard X-ray emissivity peak in normalized toroidal flux coordinate.
per_name.holder_description: Outward extent of the hard X-ray emissivity peak from its maximum to the outer half-maximum point toward the separatrix in normalized toroidal flux.

per_name.description: Signed dimensionless component of a magnetic-field perturbation along the local equilibrium magnetic-field direction, identifying compressional fluctuations.
per_name.holder_description: Dimensionless compressional electromagnetic fluctuation amplitude from the parallel magnetic-field perturbation, time- and flux-surface-averaged and summed over kx for each ky.
Poloidal momentum diffusion coefficient for ions in a specified charge state, describing effective Fickian transport of the poloidal momentum component.

per_name.description: Poloidal neutral momentum diffusivity is the diagonal poloidal component of an effective neutral-particle momentum diffusivity tensor, governing down-gradient redistribution of aggregate neutral momentum along increasing poloidal angle θ on flux surfaces in flux coordinates (ρ, θ, φ). The poloidal qualifier identifies the flux and gradient direction, not the momentum component.
per_name.holder_description: Poloidal diffusion coefficient for neutral momentum transport on the GGD grid.

per_name.description: Blackbody-equivalent brightness temperature inferred from electron cyclotron emission, approaching the local electron temperature when the resonant layer is optically thick.
per_name.holder_description: Predicted equivalent blackbody temperature of ordinary-mode electron cyclotron emission at a frequency-selective ECE channel.

per_name.description: Spectral wave opacity integrated along the channel line of sight to the electron cyclotron emission position.
per_name.holder_description: Dimensionless optical depth along the electron-cyclotron-emission viewing path at a channel emission position, indicating whether the detected emission is local and thermal.

per_name.description: Thermodynamic temperature of the component surface at the sensor attachment point.
per_name.holder_description: Thermodynamic temperature associated with a selected thermocouple sensor attached to a tokamak structural component.

per_name.description: Cumulative thermal energy extracted through a cooling-loop port on a plant component since the start of the plasma pulse, obtained by time-integrating the measured coolant enthalpy balance.
per_name.holder_description: Cumulative thermal energy transferred from a calorimetry component to its coolant since pulse start, determined from the coolant enthalpy gain.

per_name.description: Non-negative thickness of a passive conducting loop element measured between parallel bounding sides in its poloidal cross-section.
per_name.holder_description: Transverse dimension of the rectangular cross-section used to represent each passive conductor loop element, measured perpendicular to its central segment.

per_name.description: Toroidal angle (φ) coordinate of points along the pellet injection trajectory in the cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame
per_name.holder_description: Azimuthal location of a sampled point along the pellet path in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame about the machine symmetry axis. Phi increases counterclockwise when viewed from above +Z.

per_name.description: Power delivered by all neutral beam injectors at the vacuum vessel boundary, evaluated before plasma absorption, shine-through, and fast-ion first-orbit loss corrections. It is the non-negative sum of launched kinetic powers over the injectors.
per_name.holder_description: NBI power delivered into the vacuum vessel before shine-through or orbit losses.

per_name.description: Local Coulomb-collisional power density changing the kinetic-energy density of fast particles on trapped guiding-center orbits.
per_name.holder_description: Trapped fast-electron collisional power density is the signed local volumetric rate of kinetic-energy exchange for the trapped guiding-center component of the suprathermal electron population caused by Coulomb collisions.

per_name.description: Signed vertical Z coordinate of the point where a limited plasma boundary contacts the active limiter, expressed in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
per_name.holder_description: Dimensionless flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming bound on the vertical (Z) momentum-flux-density component in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame for a specified neutral particle state in edge-plasma transport closures.

per_name.description: Maximum absolute instantaneous radio-frequency voltage at the transmission-line feed of an ion-cyclotron heating antenna module during one waveform cycle.
per_name.holder_description: Peak magnitude of the radio-frequency voltage waveform on a single transmission-line feed of an ion-cyclotron-heating antenna module.

per_name.description: Width of an ICRH antenna strap in the toroidal direction.
per_name.holder_description: Full toroidal width of the rectangular cross-section of an ICRH antenna strap conductor element, measured along the toroidal direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

per_name.description: Aperture width is the non-negative clear opening extent along the first local tangential direction in a right-handed aperture-local frame (first tangential, second tangential, normal). The second local tangential direction also lies in the aperture plane, and the normal is orthogonal to that plane.
per_name.holder_description: Full clear-opening width of a rectangular collimating aperture measured along its object-local first tangential axis.
